summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-L5 admits no external crate. academic-student-voice links academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-domain, academic-lecture-document, academic-transcription and thiserror as product edges, and academic-model-run, academic-retention, tempfile and trybuild as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the five workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and thiserror was admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-student-voice is the P2-L5 boundary: section 32.5's student-voice rules and the section 38.3 question about diarization accuracy. It owns the named versioned diarization corpus and the scorer over it, the fail-closed rule that a below-threshold measurement produces no automatic-redaction claim, the redacted derivative and the restricted original one redaction produces, the capture PII hold that stands in front of graph and OCR ingestion, and the projection layer over P2-G6's deletion preview. It is a separate package from academic-lecture-document because that crate owns what the document preserves and this one owns what may be removed from a copy of it, and the direction of the edge is what keeps a coverage report constructible without a redaction and a redaction impossible without the policy reference that crate holds.

no_second_retention_rule_note: P2-G6 fixed the two independent retention bounds and the one inheritance function that narrows them, and P2-K5 fixed the closed derivative-class list and the mechanism for a voice-scoped deletion of an original. This task adds neither again. RetentionTerms::inherit is called at exactly one site in this crate -- inherit_terms -- and derivative_terms_have_one_producer counts it, so every derivative and every link of a derivative chain goes through P2-G6's own comparison. The deletion preview is academic_consent::preview_expiry called rather than forked, so the derivative-class walk and the ledger row a preview writes are that crate's. What this task adds is not a second retention rule but a second layer over one preview: which concept and evidence projections a deletion reaches.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's CaptureBytes. A held capture holds one privately and has no byte accessor at all, which is what makes the PII hold the absence of a method rather than a flag a downstream reader has to remember to consult. P2-L1's QuarantinedArtifact is the same shape one layer down and this crate reuses it rather than declaring a second capture payload type.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-G6's RetentionTerms, RetentionBound, DerivativeClass, SubjectInventory, DeletionImpact and preview_expiry. The audio and transcript bounds are two values there and a derivative inherits the stricter of each through one function; this crate calls that function and declares no inheritance rule of its own, and its deletion preview wraps that crate's rather than answering the same question twice.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: Actor, ContentDigest and LectureSessionId. Every constructor that records a human decision -- a redaction policy, a manual exclusion, a raw-access grant, a PII review -- matches the closed Actor enum exhaustively, so a fifth actor class stops this crate compiling until it is classified, and section 27.2's rule that a model may not make such a judgement is the compiler's rather than a comparison.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: P2-L4's RedactionPolicyRef and RedactionBasis. That crate's contract page leaves D-3 open in its own words: the reference holds a digest it does not resolve, and what the digest names is P2-L5's. RedactionPolicy::resolve is that closure, and taking the edge is what lets it compare the reference by value instead of a second policy vocabulary being invented here.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's Speaker, TranscriptLineage and TranscriptSegment. Speaker is section 12.4's own three shapes and that crate already holds them, so a targeting rule written over a second speaker enum would be two vocabularies for one fact. LectureSource::of takes a &TranscriptLineage, whose one producer is academic_transcription::run, so what this crate redacts is what the pipeline produced rather than utterances written here. This crate names no raw type, so P2-L3's workspace scope rule stays intact.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: The compile-fail cases are compiled against this crate plus this crate's dev-dependencies, so the retention types a derivative case names have to be reachable from a tests/compile_fail case as well. academic-consent declares its own domain edge twice for the same reason.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: The same: the digest type an admitted-capture case names has to be reachable from a compile-fail case.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: The section 27.3 run identity the real P2-L3 pipeline records, so every acceptance row drives academic_transcription::run end to end. Keeping it off the product edge is what makes 'this crate mints no provenance record' a compile error rather than a source scan.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-retention: P2-K5's GATE_38_026_STATEMENT and DerivativeClass. A dev edge for the reason academic-consent takes one: rotation_engine_lane_is_not_default holds that exactly one crate declares that product edge, because linking it links a crate that can destroy a key slot, and a redaction has no business inside that boundary. no_original_voice_authority_is_produced_here needs to name the type it refuses to produce, and the open-gate statement is compared against P2-K5's own so neither side can quietly start claiming the question is settled.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The acceptance suite drives a real academic_capture::begin, which writes a chunk journal to a real path, so the transcript every redaction runs over comes off a journal the real capture surface wrote. Already admitted for academic-capture, academic-transcription and academic-lecture-document.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. This task's fail-closed rules are types, and the seven cases under crates/student-voice/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic -- an automatic redaction mode with the measurement left out, a forged accuracy witness, a redaction scope that reaches an original, the bytes of a held capture, an admitted capture written past the hold, a second read on one access grant, and retention terms written onto a derivative after the fact.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-student-voice is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 32.5's student-voice rules, whose subject is people who never agreed to this product: DiarizationMeasurement has private fields, no Default and one producer, which walks a named versioned corpus, so an accuracy figure quoted from anywhere but a run over committed bytes has no value of that type; RedactionMode::Automatic carries an AccuracyWitness by value and a witness's one producer compares a measured permille against a configured one, so a below-threshold measurement produces no automatic-redaction claim rather than a weaker one; DiarizationThreshold::new refuses a required accuracy below an absolute floor and an allowed missed-student fraction above an absolute ceiling, so a profile cannot configure the guard away; RedactionScope has one variant and there is no Original, so a policy authorising an edit to the original recording has no spelling here at all and GATE-38-026 stays open; CaptureUnderReview holds its bytes privately with no accessor and ReviewedCapture, the one type with one, has no public constructor and is built at exactly one site inside dispatch; and RestrictedOriginal hands out the removed speech only against a RawAccessGrant it consumes by value, writing an audit row inside the call, so an authorized read is one disclosure with one record and does not lift the restriction. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so a redaction cannot reach the canonical writer and adds no migration; no academic-retention product edge, so nothing in its closure can destroy a key slot; and no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, reads no clock, and runs no build script. no_wall_clock_socket_or_file_reaches_this_crate in crates/student-voice/tests/student_voice_scans.rs scopes that to src/ and records the one exception -- examples/emit_corpus.rs writes the committed corpus and is not compiled into the library -- rather than leaving it silent. no_floating_point_reaches_this_crate refuses f32, f64 and every decimal literal anywhere in the package, tests included, because a number that decides whether somebody's voice may be processed automatically must not depend on a rounding mode; every ratio is permille in u64. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy's bundled SQLite by way of academic-model-run and academic-egress-boundary, which arrive with academic-transcription. Every corpus, timeline, transcript, capture and instant in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; the diarization corpus is two committed timelines per case rather than audio, no microphone or camera is opened, no speech engine or diarizer exists in this repository, and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-student-voice links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. thiserror was admitted by the phase 1 receipt; tempfile and trybuild are dev dependencies already admitted for academic-capture, academic-transcription and academic-lecture-document. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
